# SiteScoper

> AI-powered website audits that tell you the 3 things actually worth fixing this week — UX, SEO, copy, conversion, and accessibility, scored like a senior product strategist would.

SiteScoper crawls up to 8 of your most important pages and uses frontier AI models (GPT-5, Gemini Pro) to deliver opinionated, prioritized recommendations. Built for founders, indie hackers, and product teams who want signal, not a 200-row checklist.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Run a free AI website audit and see the SiteScoper product overview.
- [Best AI website audit tools 2026](/best-ai-website-audit-tools): Honest comparison of SiteScoper, Lighthouse, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Clarity, with pricing and what each is best at.
- [Website audit statistics](/website-audit-statistics): 21 sourced statistics on page speed, mobile UX, SEO, conversion, accessibility and AI search, each with a named source and year.
- [Blog](/blog): Practical guides on website audits, SEO and Core Web Vitals for founders.
- [Pricing](/pricing): Free plan: 3 audits/month, no card. Pro: $19/month or $180/year with a 7-day free trial and a 30-day refund — unlimited audits, deep product simulation, competitor compare, chat with report, PDF export.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How SiteScoper collects and protects your data.
